title: DnaK interacting protein All4144 of Anabaena sp. PCC 7120: A thermo-sensor GrpE that acts as a nucleotide exchange factor and binds to DNA
authors: Sonam Sriwastaw; Ruchi Rai; L.C. Rai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝藻GrpE同源蛋白All4144的HTH结构域介导的DNA结合功能及其作为DnaK核苷酸交换因子的热传感作用，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: This study investigates the critical role of the dimeric GrpE protein as a thermosensor within bacterial DnaK complexes, with a specific focus on All4144, a GrpE homolog found in Anabaena sp. PCC7120. In the present work, we characterized All4144, which possesses both the GrpE domain and a helix-turn-helix (HTH) domain. Our aim was to elucidate the functional significance of the HTH domain by selectively deleting the region encompassing residues 1-67 from the full-length All4144. Our findings reveal that both All4144 and its deletion mutant function as homo-dimeric nucleotide exchange factors for DnaK, enhancing the ATPase and refolding activities of DnaK. Additionally, All4144 plays a role in DNA binding. On the contrary, the deletion mutant lacking the HTH motif exhibits impaired DNA-binding ability, underscoring the importance of the HTH domain. Moreover, All4144 superior cell survival and thermal stability profiles, compared to the deletion mutant. Taken together, our study sheds light on the multifunctional nature of All4144, highlighting its pivotal role in modulating thermal tolerance through interactions with DnaK and DNA. PCC7120中发现的GrpE同源物All4144。在本工作中，我们对All4144进行了表征，该蛋白同时含有GrpE结构域和螺旋-转角-螺旋（helix-turn-helix, HTH）结构域。我们的目标是通过选择性删除全长All4144中涵盖残基1-67的区域，来阐明HTH结构域的功能意义。研究结果显示，All4144及其缺失突变体均作为DnaK的同源二聚体核苷酸交换因子（nucleotide exchange factor），增强DnaK的ATP酶活性和重折叠活性。此外，All4144还参与DNA结合。相反，缺乏HTH基序的缺失突变体表现出受损的DNA结合能力，这凸显了HTH结构域的重要性。而且，与缺失突变体相比，All4144展现出更优的细胞存活率和热稳定性特征。综合来看，我们的研究揭示了All4144的多功能性本质，强调了其通过与DnaK和DNA相互作用在调节耐热性中的关键作用。图形摘要：
